features.title: Upstream agents to the agent grammar
features.user_visible_behavior: Discovery, spec, validation, domain, design and task-planning agents declare trigger, boundary, tier, capabilities, ground truth, I/O contract, negative space, gates; no manifest writes.
features.evidence: Discovery, spec, validation, domain, design, task-planning agents rewritten to the agent.spec grammar: description = capability + Use when + Do NOT use (naming sibling agents/skills, no pipeline ordinal); metadata tier/workspace_mode/model_profile; capabilities (validation = auditor: deny edit_file; others specialist), write_paths, mounted core skills; limits.max_turns; Role Charter (guarantees, Operational/Quarantine Boundary, Decision Rights); Pre-Flight Reading & Ground Truth (Tier 1/2/3); typed Delegation & I/O Contract with verdict and handoff/redirect edges; Negative Space (incl. file:line execution-point, anti-hedging, quarantine, Author/Model provenance); Convergence & Verification Gate (probes + asdd check + git status negative check); Escalation Gate (phase_blocked, Context -> Options -> Recommendation -> Decision Needed). P1: '(write phase/gates)' replaced by read-only/generated in all six. Discovery's inline capability template replaced by the steering template (20131 -> 19397 bytes). Verified with the scratch structural check (all A-* slots present, sizes <= 20 KB); asdd kit agents-lint (TASK-005) re-verifies.

features.title: Downstream agents, spike researcher, single roles

features.title: Module agents; Playwright runbook as a skill

features.title: Runtime projection of capabilities
features.user_visible_behavior: Installing Claude Code, Cursor or OpenCode writes agent files with the runtime's tool envelope; other runtimes keep links; uninstall removes them.
features.evidence: New cli/src/install/agent-frontmatter.mjs parses the canonical agent frontmatter and renders per runtime: Claude Code (tools allowlist Read/Grep/Glob/Bash/Write/Edit, Agent only for the orchestrator; disallowedTools when mcp_tools is true so MCP tools stay; maxTurns), Cursor (readonly: true when write_tools is false), OpenCode (ordered permissions: edit deny * + allow write_paths, subagent deny * for non-orchestrators; steps). context.writeGenerated writes kit-owned generated files (replaces legacy links, keeps a project-edited copy unless --force, recorded in managed_files/kit_files so uninstall removes it). runtimes.mjs renders for cursor/claude/opencode; junie/devin/kiro/kimi keep links. Manual run: install into a temp repo (claude,cursor,opencode,junie, all modules): 42 RENDER, reinstall 0 RENDER/56 KEEP, asdd check exit 0, uninstall removed the rendered dirs. install.sh: new assertions (validation tools without Edit/Agent, implementation with Agent, e2e disallowedTools: Agent, maxTurns; OpenCode qa permissions; Cursor readonly only on the researcher) — bash cli/test/install.sh: OK asdd install smoke test (after kit versions registered the new files).
